steps.title: Prepare PBS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.201 g KCl, 8.0 g NaCl, 2.68 g Na₂HPO₄·7H₂O, and 0.245 g KH₂PO₄ in deionized water to a final volume of 1 L, adjust pH to 7.2–7.4, autoclave at 121 °C for 25 min.

steps.title: Prepare 0.9 % saline
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9 g NaCl in 1 L deionized water, autoclave at 121 °C for 25 min.

steps.title: Prepare urethane injection solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g urethane in 10 mL sterile PBS to obtain 100 mg/mL, filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm) and use the same day.

steps.title: Prepare LB medium
steps.instruction: Add 25 g LB broth powder to 1 L distilled water, vortex, adjust pH to 7.0 with 5 N NaOH, autoclave at 121 °C for 25 min.

steps.title: Prepare ampicillin stock (100 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g ampicillin in 10 mL sterile deionized water, filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm), aliquot 500 µL, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare LB with ampicillin
steps.instruction: Mix 499.5 mL LB medium with 0.5 mL ampicillin stock (100 µg/mL) to a total of 500 mL.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates with ampicillin
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL LB agar (20 g LB agar powder in 500 mL water, pH 7.0, autoclave, cool to ~50 °C), add 0.5 mL ampicillin stock (100 µg/mL), pour 20–25 mL per 10 cm plate.

steps.title: Prepare anti‑PD‑1 injection solution
steps.instruction: Aliquot 308 µL anti‑PD‑1 antibody (6.5 mg/mL) for 10 mice (200 µg per mouse), store at –80 °C; before injection add sterile PBS to 100 µL per 200 µg antibody.

steps.title: Prepare carboplatin stock (10 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve carboplatin in 100 mg PBS to 10 mg/mL, aliquot 1.5 mL per tube, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare paclitaxel stock (30 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve paclitaxel in 100 mg DMSO to 30 mg/mL, aliquot 250 µL per tube, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare carboplatin injection solution (3 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 1.5 mL carboplatin stock (10 mg/mL) with 3.5 mL PBS to 5 mL total (3 mg/mL); use same day.

steps.title: Prepare paclitaxel injection solution (1.5 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 250 µL paclitaxel stock (30 mg/mL) with 250 µL Tween‑80 and 4.5 mL PBS to 5 mL total (1.5 mg/mL); use same day.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid DNA solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 25 µg plasmid DNA in 50 µL 10 % glucose, add 50 µL sterile water, vortex gently, spin 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare in‑vivo‑jetPEI solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 4 µL in‑vivo‑jetPEI in 50 µL 10 % glucose, add 46 µL sterile water to 100 µL total, vortex gently, spin 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare NanoPlasmid mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 100 µL in‑vivo‑jetPEI solution with 100 µL plasmid DNA solution, vortex briefly, spin, let sit at room temperature 15 min before injection.

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia solution
steps.instruction: Mix 900 µL ketamine (100 mg/mL) with 500 µL xylazine (20 mg/mL) and 8.6 mL saline to 10 mL total (final 9 mg/mL ketamine, 1 mg/mL xylazine).

steps.title: Prepare collagenase D solution (100 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 500 mg collagenase D in 5 mL ddH₂O, aliquot 500 µL, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I solution (100 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg DNase I in 1 mL ddH₂O, aliquot 50 µL, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare lung digestion buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 44.45 mL RPMI‑1640 (HEPES, L‑glutamine), 5 mL FBS (10 %), 0.5 mL collagenase D (100 mg/mL, 1 mg/mL final), and 50 µL DNase I (100 mg/mL, 0.1 mg/mL final).

steps.title: Prepare RBC lysis buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8.29 g NH₄Cl (0.15 M), 1 g KHCO₃ (0.01 M), 37.2 mg Na₂‑EDTA (0.1 mM) in deionized water, adjust pH 7.2–7.4, filter (0.22 µm), store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare flow cytometry staining buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 g BSA in 50 mL PBS (1 % BSA).

steps.title: Prepare culture medium (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 89 mL RPMI‑1640, 10 mL FBS (10 %), 1 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (10 000 U/mL, to give 100 U/mL).

steps.title: Prepare PMA stock (100 µg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve PMA to 100 µg/mL in 0.1 mg DMSO, bring volume to 1 mL, aliquot 50 µL, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare ionomycin stock (1 mM)
steps.instruction: Dissolve ionomycin to 1 mM in 1 mg RPMI‑1640, bring volume to 1.34 mL, aliquot 50 µL, store at –80 °C, protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare 1× permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 × permeabilization buffer 1:10 with distilled water (10 mL buffer + 90 mL water).

steps.title: Induce lung tumors with urethane
steps.instruction: Inject 6–8‑week‑old FVB/NJ mice intraperitoneally (IP) weekly for 6 weeks with urethane 1 mg/g body weight (0.1 mL of 100 mg/mL urethane per 10 g).

substeps.instruction: Weigh each mouse, calculate injection volume.
Disinfect urethane container top with 70 % alcohol and gauze.
Draw calculated volume into a syringe with a 30 G needle.
Restrain mouse by scruff, insert needle at 30–45° bevel up into lower right/left abdominal quadrant.
Confirm negative pressure before injection; if absent, reposition needle.
Inject slowly, withdraw needle, monitor mouse every 15 min until recovery (sternal recumbency, ambulatory).
Keep mouse warm with circulating water blanket or equivalent.
Record weight, condition, and behavior weekly; monitor daily for distress.

steps.title: Transform competent E. coli
steps.instruction: Introduce plasmid DNA into DH5α cells for PDLIM2 or control vector.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 50 µL chemically competent DH5α on ice 10 min.
Add 1–5 ng plasmid DNA, flick gently, incubate on ice 30 min.
Heat shock at 42 °C for 45 s, return to ice 2 min.
Add 450 µL SOC or LB, shake 225 rpm at 37 °C for 1 h.
Plate 100–200 µL on LB agar + ampicillin (100 µg/mL), incubate overnight 37 °C.

steps.title: Amplify and purify plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Grow transformed colonies and isolate endotoxin‑free plasmid for in‑vivo use.

substeps.instruction: Pick a single colony, inoculate 2–5 mL LB + ampicillin (100 µg/mL), grow ~8 h at 37 °C, 300 rpm.
Dilute 1:500–1:1000 into 100 mL LB + ampicillin (100 µg/mL) in a flask ≥4× culture volume, grow 12–16 h at 37 °C, 300 rpm to OD ≈3–4 × 10⁹ cells/mL.
Harvest cells, extract plasmid with Qiagen EndoFree Plasmid Maxi kit per manufacturer.
Measure DNA concentration (NanoDrop) and verify by restriction digest or agarose gel.

steps.title: Form NanoPDLIM2 complexes
steps.instruction: Combine plasmid DNA with in‑vivo‑jetPEI to generate nanoparticles for IV injection.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 25 µg plasmid DNA in 50 µL 10 % glucose, add 50 µL sterile water (total 100 µL).
Dilute 4 µL in‑vivo‑jetPEI in 50 µL 10 % glucose, add 46 µL sterile water (total 100 µL).
Add the 100 µL PEI solution to the 100 µL DNA solution, vortex briefly, spin down.
Incubate at room temperature 15 min to allow nanoparticle formation; keep on ice until injection.

steps.title: Administer weekly treatments (6 weeks)
steps.instruction: Deliver nanoPDLIM2, carboplatin/paclitaxel, and anti‑PD‑1 according to schedule.

substeps.instruction: IV nanoPlasmid: Warm mouse tail 2–5 min, load 200 µL NanoPlasmid into 30 G insulin syringe, remove bubbles, disinfect site, insert needle at 10–15° into lateral tail vein, aspirate lightly, inject 200 µL over 5–10 s, press gauze, monitor 15–30 min.
IP carboplatin/paclitaxel: Calculate dose 30 mg/kg carboplatin (3 mg/mL) and 15 mg/kg paclitaxel (1.5 mg/mL). Inject 100 µL per 10 g body weight of carboplatin first, then paclitaxel, weekly.
IP anti‑PD‑1: Inject 200 µL of anti‑PD‑1 solution (1 µg/µL, 200 µg per mouse) three times per week.
Repeat all three injections weekly for a total of 6 weeks.

steps.title: Euthanize and collect tissues
steps.instruction: Harvest lungs, blood, and other organs 6 weeks after final urethane injection for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Weigh mouse, calculate anesthesia dose (0.1 mL per 10 g of anesthesia solution).
IP inject anesthesia solution, confirm lack of toe‑pinch response.
Collect blood via cardiac puncture, retro‑orbital sinus, or tail vein into appropriate tubes.
Euthanize by cervical dislocation.
Make ventral incision from abdomen to sternum, cut ribcage to expose lungs.
Optional: perfuse with PBS via cardiac route before lung removal.
Detach lungs, place in PBS‑filled Petri dish.
Under dissecting microscope, count and measure tumor nodules with microcaliper; record number, size, distribution.
Inspect and photograph other organs (liver, spleen, kidney, etc.).
Collect tissue pieces: flash‑freeze for molecular assays, fix in 10 % NBF for IHC/IF, embed in OCT for frozen sections, or proceed immediately to single‑cell dissociation.

steps.title: Isolate single cells from lung
steps.instruction: Generate a single‑cell suspension from lung tissue for flow cytometry or scRNA‑seq.

substeps.instruction: Place lung lobes on ice, mince with sterile scissors.
Transfer minced tissue to 2 mL pre‑warmed lung digestion buffer, mix.
Incubate 45 min at 37 °C with gentle shaking.
Pass mixture through 70 µm cell strainer into 50 mL tube; use syringe plunger to press tissue.
Rinse strainer with 5 mL flow cytometry staining buffer.
Centrifuge 400 × g 10 min RT, discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1–2 mL RBC lysis buffer, incubate 5 min RT.
Add 10× volume of staining buffer to neutralize, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min RT.
If intracellular staining is planned, resuspend in culture medium; otherwise, resuspend in staining buffer, count cells, proceed to staining.

steps.title: Stimulate cells for intracellular cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Activate cells to accumulate cytokines before intracellular staining.

substeps.instruction: Plate cells in 6‑well plates with culture medium.
Add PMA to 50 ng/mL, ionomycin to 1 µM, brefeldin A (3 µg/mL, 1×), and monensin (2 µM, 1×).
Incubate 4 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.
Collect cells, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min RT.
Resuspend pellet in staining buffer, count, and proceed to flow cytometry staining.

steps.title: Perform flow cytometry staining
steps.instruction: Stain surface and intracellular markers for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 1–2 × 10⁶ cells per 5 mL tube, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL anti‑CD16/CD32 (Fc block, 1:100) in staining buffer, incubate 5 min RT.
Add 50 µL master mix of fluorochrome‑conjugated surface antibodies, incubate 30 min RT in dark.
Wash twice with 1 mL staining buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min 4 °C.
Resuspend cells in 200 µL staining buffer for acquisition or continue to intracellular staining:
a. Fix with 100 µL IC fixation buffer, vortex, incubate 20–60 min RT dark.
b. Wash twice with 2 mL 1× permeabilization buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min RT.
c. Resuspend in 100 µL 1× permeabilization buffer, add intracellular antibody mix, incubate 20–60 min RT dark.
d. Wash twice with 2 mL permeabilization buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min RT.
e. Resuspend in appropriate volume of staining buffer for acquisition.
Acquire data on flow cytometer (e.g., BD LSRFortessa). Use compensation beads, unstained, and FMO controls.
